items.item:
4. An alias of 40 characters is stored; one of 41 is refused and nothing
   changes.
   Shows A02-5. [witness: verification:registry_a02_alias_over_forty_code_points_refused]
statements:
area absent or area > OBJECT_FLOOR_AREA_MIN_EXCLUSIVE
                         floor absent or floor is a whole number
for every stored alias a: a absent or code_points(a) <= ALIAS_MAX_CHARACTERS   -- A02-5

verdicts.why: The check asserts that 40-code-point aliases are stored, 41-code-point aliases are refused on creation and correction, and refusal leaves the store/card unchanged. It only exercises absent area and floor values; it does not assert that present area must exceed the minimum or that present floor must be a whole number.
